landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.1.a: No. We only ask Google for permission to send emails. We never read, list or delete your messages.
landing.faq.2.q: Can I send twice to the same company?
landing.faq.2.a: No. Each company receives at most one application from you.
landing.faq.3.q: What if I want to review before sending?
landing.faq.3.a: Choose the plan with review mode: you read and edit each email before it leaves.
landing.faq.4.q: Do you guarantee interviews or replies?
landing.faq.4.a: No. We widen the reach and improve the quality of your applications, but replies depend on the recruiter.
landing.faq.5.q: Could this make my email look like spam?
landing.faq.5.a: We reduce that risk: at most one application per company, a message filled in with each job's details, paced sends one at a time, and a daily limit per plan. Even so, we can't guarantee how each email provider will treat the messages.
landing.faq.6.q: How can a company ask not to receive applications?
landing.faq.6.a: Through the opt-out page linked in the footer. Once confirmed, the company stops receiving applications.
landing.cta.title: Start with invite-only access.
landing.email.note: We only use your email permission to send the applications you choose or allow. We never read your inbox.
